acip: ,NYON MONGS SHES BYA'I SGRIB PA YI, ,MUN PA'I GNYEN PO STONG PA NYID, ,MYUR DU THAMS CAD MKHYEN 'DOD PAS, ,DE NI JI LTAR SGOM MI BYED,
wylie: nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib pa yi, ,mun pa'i gnyen po stong pa nyid, ,myur du thams cad mkhyen 'dod pas, ,de ni ji ltar sgom mi byed
english: Emptiness is the antidote For the darkness of the obstacles Of affliction and to omniscience. How could it be that those Who hope for omniscience quickly Would neglect meditating upon it?
